## Workload

Elif Sahin graded 813 sets during 402 rostered hours, giving an average throughput of 2.0 sets per hour. This record provides the workload measure for the review period and indicates the volume completed against the hours available. The current session pattern was considered alongside the workload information. Following discussion, the grader and reviewer agreed to retain the current session pattern.

## Quality

A sample of 74 sets was read again as part of the quality review. Agreement between the original grading and the subsequent review was 71.6 per cent. The result was considered together with the workload record rather than in isolation. The review was completed by Priya Anand, with Elif Sahin identified as the grader.
